svg.title: How the four Zoldenburg products fit together
svg.desc: Zold app owns users, passkey-owned Safes, the Monerium IBAN and the books. Zold Pay lets merchants get paid and asks the Zold app for the payee Safe. The agent payment hub speaks x402 and MPP for buying agents and selling servers, and relays USDC transfers straight into the merchant's Safe. shareme.lol hosts files for agents and charges through the hub. USDC lands in the merchant's own Safe on Base; the books convert it to EURe and Monerium pays out by SEPA. Funds never pass through Zold, Zold Pay or the hub.

g.text: PAY FOR A URL OR TOOL
x402 v2 and MPP for agents
that buy and servers that sell.
The merchant's own Safe on Base
Its owner is a passkey on the merchant's device. No server holds a key that can move it.
Books auto-convert USDC to EURe, per invoice
Funds never pass through Zold, Zold Pay or the hub. Zold pays relay gas and never holds the money.
